description:
For a limited time, the L Train Disc will feature a high performance Shimano Alfine 8-Speed hub. The enhanced internal architecture of the Alfine hub takes the fast, zippy nature of the L Train and brings it one step further with increased drive efficiency and gear range.
Designed by Priority's founder Dave Weiner in collaboration with Brilliant Bicycle Co., the new L Train commuter bicycle will take you anywhere you need to go, with ease. Its chromoly frame is light and agile, and the grease and rust free Gates Carbon Drive belt paired with an internally geared hub rides for thousands of miles without ever needing a tune-up.

Gates Carbon Drive Belt (Say 'bye' to grease!)
Shimano Internally Geared Hub, Available in 7 speed or 8 speed.
Lightweight Triple-Butted Chromoly Frame
Puncture Resistant 32mm Tires
Kickstand Included!

The Brilliant L Train is an ideal fit for that rider looking for a nimble, quick bicycle with larger gear range to tackle any commute or leisure ride.
The V-Brake version comes with a grip shifter while the Hydraulic Disc brake version comes with a trigger shifter. All Pantone models come with trigger shifters.
PSA: Most bicycles are selling out before they are produced. Our individual product pages reflect the most accurate back-order and ship dates for each model. These dates are updated in real-time for future purchases, and we generally sell out of most models before the date posted. Secure your ship date with a back-order, which can be cancelled at any time for a full refund before your bicycle ships.
Fenders make a great addition to any commuter!

components.description: The signature feature of all Priority Bicycles - the rust and grease free Carbon Drive belt. Originally designed for use in automotive applications, the Carbon Drive belt manages torque much better than a chain and won’t break like a chain leaving you stranded. Plus, it won’t stain your hands or clothing!

Unchain yourself from clunky, greasy traditional casette and deraileur systems. Internally geared hubs run longer and don't demand the same routine maintenance as traditional rear derailleur sets. This makes for a low hassle, ultra smooth ride. Once you try it, you won't go back.
If you put on accessories like a front basket or a rear rack to hold pannier bags, make sure you bike is balanced and not going to tip over!
A sporty saddle and comfortable wrapped grips are weather resistant for adverse conditions.
Fight flats, thorns, and road debris with puncture resistant tires. The 700c x 32 tires are responsive on your rides while still having a bit of width for comfort.
